article.title: Lula and the terrible realities of the era of counterrevolution: The Forty-Fifth Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Editor
article.content: This October, millions of Brazilian workers mobilised to defeat the far right; now the essential task begins: strengthening mass movements and forging a sovereign economic policy that develops Brazil’s productive forces.
